posts.text: What’s happening with the Belfast riots? The rioting that started in Belfast Ireland is linked to an action that has no place in society, but some people, including @BraedenSorbo , are trying to make it about the origin of the perpetrator, and include everyone who looks like him, in their indictment. That’s wrong.

posts.text: Does Los Angeles County have a 112% registration rate? The question was asked because a lawsuit alleged that. But the truth is that Los Angeles County keeps active and inactive voters (who can’t vote) in  its voter rolls. This makes the total number of  registrations contained in the rolls larger than the voting population, but only because inactive voters may have passed or moved out of the county.  Let’s fact check @Truly Salty

posts.text: A federal court blocked a Trump order that would have transferred 14 transgender women from a women’s federal prison to a men’s facility.  The judge referenced the danger to these women in his decision.  The Trump administration order originates from Trump’s Executive Order 14168 requiring that all federal inmates be housed in a facility that matches their assigned gender at birth.

posts.text: Since June is Pride month, many complain that there should be a month dedicated to other things, including god.  Those who argue that, if there’s a month for Pride, there should be an entire month to celebrate God, usually mean “Christianity”, and not just any deity.  But there already is a month like that.  Let’s fact check @merriamfaith and her position.
